# Nier Gray Tokens

## Palette
| Token | Value |
|---|---|
| `bg.canvas` | `#111111` |
| `bg.panel` | `#1B1A17` |
| `fg.primary` | `#ECE6D9` |
| `fg.secondary` | `#B7B0A3` |
| `line.strong` | `#D7D0C4` |
| `line.soft` | `#5F5A52` |
| `accent.signal` | `#CFC7B8` |

## Typography
- `title.family = serif-display`
- `body.family = humanist-sans`
- `meta.family = monospace`

## Rules
- docs 与 demo 共用相同 token 名
- 优先使用编号式章节标题
- 强分隔线、薄边框卡片、低饱和对比
- 不引入高饱和强调色破坏黑白灰主调
